name: pr-tools
description: Pull request review and fix loops inside your Claude Code session.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews each pull request push with a read-only reviewer agent and posts one PR comment and a pr-reviewer commit status. Hands findings to pr-fixer when installed.

plugins.name: pr-fixer
plugins.description: Fixes pull request review findings from any reviewer, until a review is clean, and blocks git commands that bypass the PR flow.
